integrity: The proof starts from the source's exact reduced determinant formula and the standard second-coefficient Schwarz estimate. A reverse-triangle inequality gives the global lower floor, and equality is traced through every step to the Schwarz-lemma extremizers. Finite sampling was used only as a consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the sixth-order symmetric Toeplitz determinant for the odd complex exponential starlike class. The lower estimate is a modulus bound; it is not asserted for the full complex Janowski family or for higher determinant orders. The sharp complex upper bound is taken from the cited source.
title: Sharp complex lower bound for the sixth-order exponential Toeplitz determinant
